description_en: Changes the billing method of a Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance from pay-as-you-go to subscription
description_zh: 将按量计费实例转换为包年包月实例
kebab_example: aliyun slb modify-load-balancer-pay-type --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-bp1b6c719dfa08ex00000 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyLoadBalancerPayType

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the CLB instance is deployed.

You can query the region ID from the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html list or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例的地域ID。

您可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html列表或通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CLB instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the CLB instance. Valid values:

PayOnDemand (default): pay-as-you-go

To change the billing method of a pay-as-you-go CLB instance to subscription, you must set the parameter to PrePay. In addition, the previous billing method of the CLB instance must be PayOnDemand
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例付费模式，取值：

<props="china">- PrePay：包年包月。</props>

PayOnDemand（默认值）：按量付费。

按量计费转为包年包月计费，该参数取值只能为PrePay，且该实例之前的计费模式必须为PayOnDemand
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing cycle.

Valid values: year and month.

This parameter is valid only when the PayType parameter is set to PrePay. This parameter is valid only for pay-as-you-go instances
parameters.help_zh:
计费周期。

取值：year或month 。

只有当PayType的参数取值为PrePay时有效，即仅对按量计费实例有效
parameters.name: pricing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration.

If PricingCycle is set to month, the valid values are 1 to 9.

If PricingCycle is set to year, the valid values are 1 to 3.

This parameter is valid only when the PayType parameter is set to PrePay. This parameter is valid only for pay-as-you-go instances
parameters.help_zh:
计费时长。

如果PricingCycle为month，取值1~9。

如果PricingCycle为year，取值1~5。

只有当PayType的参数取值为PrePay时有效，即仅对按量计费实例有效
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

true: yes

false (default): no

This parameter is valid only when the `PayType` parameter is set to PrePay. This parameter is valid only for pay-as-you-go instances
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付费。取值：

true：自动付费。

false（默认值）：不自动付费。

只有当PayType的参数取值为PrePay时有效，即仅对按量计费实例有效
parameters.name: auto_pay

OrderId.description_en: The order ID of the subscription CLB instance
